title: CAPIT Methodology | Sources, Verification, and Publication Rules
description: Learn how CAPIT collects, normalizes, verifies, and publishes well-plugging records and related protocol activity on the Base network.
headline: CAPIT Methodology
body: This page explains how CAPIT collects state-level source records, applies strict publication rules, handles revisions, and links public infrastructure data to permanent protocol activity on the Base network.

sections.heading: Core Verification Architecture
sections.body: The CAPIT system enforces strict claim boundaries to ensure that every tokenized asset reflects verifiable physical reality. The flow executes in a highly structured pipeline spanning collection, normalization, verification, publication, and deterministic Base network minting.

sections.heading: Data Collection & Source Hierarchy
sections.body: We prioritize primary regulatory sources, ingesting public records directly from official state oil and gas conservation commissions via direct database feeds, GIS REST servers, and headless scraper fallbacks for legacy systems.

sections.heading: Data Normalization & Deduplication
sections.body: Because state data fields vary widely across jurisdictions, CAPIT standardizes incoming records into a unified schema to ensure strict taxonomy alignment and spatial deduplication.

sections.heading: Deterministic 1:1 Minting Logic
sections.body: CAPIT enforces a non-inflationary minting formula on the Base network. Supply growth is tied exclusively to physical reality: exactly one (1) CAPIT token is minted for each newly verified plugged well. There is no administrative body with the discretion to override or batch-issue tokens without an accompanying, publicly verifiable state regulatory record.

sections.heading: Immutable Revision Handling
sections.body: When a state agency updates a well filing, CAPIT employs append-only logging. Historical records are preserved to ensure absolute transparency and prevent silent overwriting of critical environmental infrastructure data.
